races.name: Blackmore Build And Design Handicap

runners_data.name: Man Of The Sea
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with proven course form, 215 days off but scored fresh before, tactical advantage crucial
runners_data.comment: Dual course winner and he needs watching in market back on the Flat on his return
runners_data.spotlight: Has done a lot of his winning in Jersey but he scored here (1m5f, firm) in the autumn and was runner-up over hurdles at Taunton (2m3f) in his final run in 2025; returns after 141 days off but he needs watching in market back on the Flat.

runners_data.name: Peking Opera
runners_data.note: Former Listed winner but struggling recent form, needs to overcome 49-day break and find old spark under Queally
runners_data.comment: Has struggled under both codes for some time and he's hard to trust at the moment
runners_data.spotlight: Listed Flat winner for Aidan O'Brien; made a successful hurdle debut for this yard in early 2024 but it's been a struggle since then under both codes; has dropped a long way in the weights but he's hard to trust at the moment and others are preferred.

runners_data.name: Educator
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with strong recent form, Hollie Doyle's tactical skills vital in crowded field of similar styles
runners_data.comment: Flopped at Newcastle latest but that was a Class 3 and has claims if he can bounce back
runners_data.spotlight: Triple turf winner who finished well to go close off this mark at Kempton (2m, AW) in January; flopped with a heavy defeat at Newcastle the following month but that was a Class 3 and has claims if he can bounce back after a short break; has form on good to firm and good to soft.

runners_data.name: Bashful Boy
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse in fair AW form, 10-year-old needs perfect pace setup to showcase closing kick
runners_data.comment: In fair form on AW this spring but he hasn't won since 2023; needs to find more
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran who hasn't won since 2023 but he's been in fair form on AW this spring including when fourth on Polytrack (2m) in his last two starts; should be in the mix again but he needs to find more to make a big impact; cheekpieces are removed and blinkers return.

runners_data.name: No More Bolero
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 175-day layoff, mixed recent form but proven at this distance when right
runners_data.comment: Hard to predict but he's on a workable mark back on the Flat and conditions should be fine
runners_data.spotlight: Turned things around back over hurdles with a win at Ludlow (2m, good) in November but he was a well-held third in a small field at Sedgefield the following month; bit to prove again after that but conditions should be fine back in this sphere and he's well treated on his close call at Chester last autumn; not ruled out on his return.

runners_data.name: The Craftymaster
runners_data.note: Hold-up style on lowest weight, recent AW winner could benefit if race becomes tactical scramble
runners_data.comment: Nine-time AW winner but he's struggled in his six runs on turf; opposable
runners_data.spotlight: Got back on the scoresheet at Lingfield (2m, AW) last month and he ran to a similar level when fourth at Wolverhampton (1m6f) 11 days ago; on lower mark back on turf but he's struggled in his six runs in this sphere including three 2m handicaps; risks attached.

runners_data.name: Lusaka
runners_data.note: Versatile runner despite hold-up label, 55 days off and inconsistent profile makes him hard to assess
runners_data.comment: Six wins on turf but all over shorter trips and he's been quiet on AW this winter
runners_data.spotlight: Often a front-runner but he's a tactically versatile; six wins on turf (1m4f-1m6f) but he's not easy to predict and has been quiet on AW this winter; now only 1lb higher than for his last success but he still has stamina to prove at this trip and others are preferred.

races.paceDynamic: Man Of The Sea takes the field along from the front with no obvious challengers for the early lead, creating a controlled tempo over the extended distance. Peking Opera and No More Bolero may track in behind but neither are natural pace forcers, while the bulk of the field (Educator, Bashful Boy, The Craftymaster, Lusaka) are hold-up merchants who need the race to come to them. With minimal early pace pressure, Man Of The Sea can dictate fractions and potentially steal a march, while the hold-up brigade risk getting caught flat-footed if the tempo is too sedate. This race shape clearly favours the front-runner and any prominent racers who can position themselves handy, as the abundance of hold-up horses creates a tactical logjam behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Man Of The Sea gets an uncontested lead and maintains a steady but not excessive tempo
scenarios.body: The 10-year-old can use his tactical advantage to build an insurmountable lead while the hold-up horses struggle to organize a coherent challenge from the back. His recent course win and proven stamina make him perfectly suited to exploit this weak pace scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and bunches the field up for a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The quality hold-up horses get their preferred scenario with Educator and Bashful Boy able to unleash their superior turn of foot in the final furlong. Hollie Doyle's tactical acumen on Educator becomes crucial in timing the late challenge perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Peking Opera or No More Bolero position themselves perfectly behind the leader and pounce late
scenarios.body: The former Listed winner Peking Opera uses class to tell, stalking Man Of The Sea before finding extra gear that the front-runner cannot match. This scenario requires perfect positioning from Queally to avoid getting caught in the hold-up traffic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unconventional Winner Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the race develops into a messy tactical affair with multiple false starts in the straight
scenarios.body: The Craftymaster or Lusaka benefit from the chaos, with their recent AW form translating well to this tactical puzzle. Their lower weights become telling factors when the principals neutralize each other through poor positioning.

watchPoints.text: Man Of The Sea must be monitored early - if he gets a soft lead unchallenged, the hold-up horses may have left themselves too much to do
The pace development in the first half-mile is crucial - with so many hold-up horses, any dawdling tempo plays into the front-runner's hands
Watch Peking Opera's position turning for home - his class advantage only counts if Queally can find a clear run through the hold-up traffic
The Craftymaster's low weight could be significant if this becomes a messy tactical affair with multiple runners still in contention late
Educator's finishing kick needs monitoring - if the pace is genuine early, her hold-up style becomes much more potent

races.paceDynamic: Connie's Rose is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate a comfortable early gallop without pressure. Behind her, five horses (Mr Lightside, Arabian Cobra, Jax Edge, Hunky Dory, Safari Dream) all want prominent positions, creating congestion and scrimmaging through the first 2-3 furlongs. This congestion will compromise some prominent runners and allow the patient hold-up horses like Strike, Moe's Legacy, Justcallmepete, and Mumayaz to get clear runs approaching the final furlong. The race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early traffic and finish with late runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners get tangled up in traffic 2-3 furlongs out
scenarios.body: The patient types get clear runs while the scrimmagers pay for their early positioning battles. Strike, Moe's Legacy and Mumayaz can unleash finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Connie's Rose Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Connie's Rose gets an uncontested lead and the prominent pack doesn't organize
scenarios.body: She builds an unassailable advantage while the chasers fight each other, holding on despite her 179-day layoff. The front-runner's tactics prove perfect for the chaotic field behind.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Breaks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses avoids the early traffic and gets first run
scenarios.body: Arabian Cobra or Hunky Dory escapes the congestion cleanly and kicks clear before the hold-up horses can respond. Their class tells in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Connie's Rose goes too slow and all prominent runners wait too long
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole with no horse having a clear tactical advantage. Form and fitness become the deciding factors rather than running style.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic chaos 2-3 furlongs out when five prominent runners (Mr Lightside, Arabian Cobra, Jax Edge, Hunky Dory, Safari Dream) converge
Monitor Connie's Rose's early fractions - if too slow she invites trouble, if too fast she may not last home after 179 days off
Track which prominent horses get squeezed in the early battle as this will determine the winners
Several key contenders (Strike, Aces Wild, Jax Edge) return after 165+ day breaks with fitness questions
Watch for Moe's Legacy and Mumayaz to be held up longest as they have the best recent form among the patient types

races.paceDynamic: Starmade, Marcellinus and Red Snapper will ensure a strong gallop from the flag, with six prominent runners (Blue Orbit, Coyy, Romeo Montague, Campenaerts, Grey Horizon, Akabusi, Quantum Power, Carefree Dream) creating serious congestion behind the leaders. The pace will be testing over this sharp 5½f at Bath, with the prominent pack likely to encounter traffic problems turning for home. This setup strongly favours the hold-up horses who can avoid the early scrimmaging - Wedonttelllies, Noble Vow, Concert and Alvin have the tactical advantage to pick off tired leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses profit
scenarios.trigger: If the three confirmed leaders set a strong gallop and the prominent pack encounters traffic
scenarios.body: The testing pace will set up perfectly for Wedonttelllies, Noble Vow, Concert and Alvin to sweep past tiring front-runners. These hold-up horses avoid the early congestion and have proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-runners steal it
scenarios.trigger: If one of the three leaders gets an easy time by going clear early
scenarios.body: Red Snapper or Starmade could dictate terms if they escape the pack, with their natural speed proving decisive over this sharp track. The hold-up horses would need the pace to collapse completely to reel them in.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent runners prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack can navigate the traffic and the pace isn't as strong as expected
scenarios.body: Blue Orbit returning from a wind operation or Campenaerts dropping in class could time their challenge perfectly from prominent positions. They avoid both the early burn of the leaders and the ground-making task of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses early
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast and burn out before halfway

races.paceDynamic: Tough Date will lead uncontested from the start with his prominent style, creating a steady, sustainable pace throughout the 1m trip. The field behind will string out with Ourbren, Ocean Force, Three No Trumps, Miss Mambo and Lamlash all adopting hold-up tactics, leaving no early pressure on the leader. This honest gallop will favour prominent runners who can sit close to the pace, as the field will have plenty to do from midfield and beyond against an uncontested front-runner. Hold-up horses face a significant tactical disadvantage with no early pace pressure to set up their late kick.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Tough Date maintains a steady tempo without early pressure from the field
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows him to dictate terms and kick clear in the straight, making it difficult for hold-up horses to close the gap. His recent third at this C&D shows he handles the track and trip effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Quality Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the class difference proves decisive despite tactical disadvantage
scenarios.body: Ourbren and Three No Trumps overcome the unfavorable pace scenario through superior ability, with their higher ratings allowing them to close strongly. The good going conditions help their finishing kicks from off the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lightly Raced Improver Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Malakai Kite shows natural improvement from his debut experiences
scenarios.body: The unknown quantity benefits from sitting closer to the pace than the other hold-up horses, allowing him to strike when the rest are still working their way into contention. His pedigree suggests this trip and conditions should suit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Upset
scenarios.trigger: If Tough Date fails to handle the step up in class and fades dramatically
scenarios.body: The front-runner's limitations are exposed against stronger opposition, creating a scramble where any of the hold-up horses can capitalize. Miss Mambo or Ocean Force could sneak through at big prices in a messy finish.

watchPoints.text: Tough Date could steal this if he gets uncontested lead as expected with no early pace pressure
Ourbren needs to overcome tactical disadvantage of sitting behind honest pace with his hold-up style
Malakai Kite's running style remains unknown which could be crucial in determining his chances
Ocean Force's 140lb weight burden looks punitive for a horse with limited exposed ability
Miss Mambo has shown no progress in three starts and appears outclassed in this company

races.paceDynamic: Silver State and Trio are both confirmed front-runners who will contest the early pace, ensuring an honest gallop from the start. With both pace-setters carrying 135lbs and 133lbs respectively, they're likely to soften each other up through the middle sections of this 1m contest on good to firm ground. The sustained pace will create a strong test of stamina in the final 2f, with the race likely to develop into a sprint finish between horses that have conserved energy. This pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses and patient tactics, as the early leaders will have done the donkey work.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Silver State and Trio engage in their expected pace duel through the first 6f
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will set up perfectly for the hold-up brigade to sweep past the tiring leaders in the final furlong. Armstrong and Chapman's Peak, both proven over the trip with strong finishing kicks, will benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runners Collapse Early
scenarios.trigger: If both Silver State and Trio go too fast early and crack before the 2f pole
scenarios.body: The pace will completely fall apart, turning this into a messy tactical affair where prominent racers can dictate terms. Crafty Blue and Tewkesbury will be perfectly positioned to capitalise on the pace collapse and control the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: One Pace-Setter Survives
scenarios.trigger: If either Silver State or Trio gets first run on their rival and kicks clear
scenarios.body: The surviving front-runner will have stolen a march on the field and proven too strong for the closers. Silver State's recent form edge gives him the better chance of executing this front-running strategy successfully.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Suits All
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners show unexpected restraint and settle into a steady rhythm
scenarios.body: The race becomes a level playing field where class and current form become the deciding factors rather than tactics. This neutralises the tactical angles and brings multiple running styles into contention.

watchPoints.text: Silver State and Trio must be monitored closely in the opening 2f - if they go suicidally fast, the race will fall apart completely
Armstrong carries significant market confidence on his second handicap start but any signs of ring rustiness could derail his chances
Tewkesbury's jumping from the stalls is crucial given his slow start last time in a tactical race like this
Chapman's Peak faces a fitness test after 170 days off but Jamie Spencer's booking suggests strong stable confidence
The hold-up horses Grand Pier, Foothold and Glasgow Kiss need the predicted strong pace to materialise to show their best

races.paceDynamic: My Ambition appears the most likely pace-setter given his front-running second at Lingfield and triple C&D winning record, with Rating and Eye Of The Water potentially joining him in the early positions. With limited early pace in this handicap field, the tempo should be sustainable rather than fierce, allowing the leaders to dictate terms through measured fractions. The lack of genuine speed horses means those who can get into contention early will have a significant tactical advantage, making this a race that strongly favours prominent runners and front-runners over hold-up horses who rely on a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If My Ambition or Rating establish an uncontested lead and maintain steady fractions
scenarios.body: The leader dictates comfortable splits and has enough left to repel late challengers on this sharp Bath track. Hold-up horses struggle to make up ground against the modest pace and rails-to-stands kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Rating and Eye Of The Water press My Ambition early, creating a three-way speed duel
scenarios.body: The increased early pace stretches the field and sets up the race for a closer who can find the right passage through. Those who can travel just behind the speed battle are perfectly positioned to strike.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace collapses completely with My Ambition going too slow through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and recent form matter most over track position. Horses with tactical speed from midfield can quicken past tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the handicapper has been overly harsh on the market leaders and an unconsidered runner finds improvement
scenarios.body: A horse returning from a break or stepping up significantly on recent form capitalizes on a soft pace scenario. The winner emerges from an unexpected source at rewarding odds.

watchPoints.text: My Ambition breaking smartly and establishing an easy lead could set up an unassailable front-running victory
Rating settling worse than expected would remove a key pace element and make the race even more tactical
Galaxy Wonder traveling strongly into the straight after his recent progressive AW form suggests continued improvement
Dappled Light's early positioning will reveal whether the long break has affected his usual hold-up racing style
Always Fearless showing his recent Wolverhampton sharpness in the preliminaries after disappointing subsequent runs

races.paceDynamic: Weston Court is the sole confirmed front-runner and should get an uncontested lead with Judge Frank and Kev the only prominent runners likely to track him. The lack of early pace will create a sustainable tempo through the middle sections, allowing the hold-up horses (Study Up, Annexation, Ajrad, Havana Tobouggaloo, Too Much Trevor, Eutropia) to get into contention turning for home. This controlled pace strongly favours closers who can quicken off a solid tempo, as the leaders will have plenty left for the finish but won't have built an unassailable advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Weston Court gets an easy lead and sustainable fractions...
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get perfect conditions to close with quickening pace over the final 2f. Annexation and Eutropia benefit most from being able to unleash finishing kicks off the steady gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Weston Court builds decisive advantage and stays on strongly...
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows him to control completely and kick clear when challenged. Judge Frank may chase him home but can't match the sustained drive of the leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Duo Take Over
scenarios.trigger: If Judge Frank and Kev press Weston Court from early stages...
scenarios.body: The increased tempo burns off the front-runner's finishing kick and sets up the race for horses tracking the pace. Judge Frank's recent form edge gives him slight advantage over Kev.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the final furlong...
scenarios.body: A horse with a big finishing kick from the back exploits the stop-start nature. Study Up or Too Much Trevor could benefit from the chaotic finish despite their recent poor form.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Weston Court gets pressed early by Judge Frank or Kev - could compromise his stamina reserves for the finish
Monitor Havana Tobouggaloo's market support given her 163-day absence and stable change to Zoe Hawkins
Check if Study Up shows early alertness with the headgear applied after his recent disappointing efforts
Observe Too Much Trevor's starting position - his poor fresh record makes fitness a major concern
Watch for Annexation travelling kindly in the rear group as sign of his recent revival continuing
